vc_checking.summary: All five target manual VCs are semantically proofable under the current annotation and case-lib seed. They share one circular-doubly-linked-list traversal family: open the sentinel representation, move one concrete node from the remaining segment to the traversed prefix, prove the unsigned increment does not wrap from the total-length bound, and recompose the unchanged list at return. Group-local proved segment append/recomposition helpers are likely useful; no annotation or seed-spec change is required.

witnesses.pure_plan: Simplify app nil nodes, Zlength nil, and zero addition. Reuse the size bound directly; all equalities reduce by simplification.
premise_discharge: xizi_dll_open consumes exactly the precondition xizi_dll resource.
The only nontrivial pure postcondition is the original size bound PreH2.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Initializes the same prefix/suffix representation transformed by the two loop-preservation witnesses.

witnesses.space_plan: Preserve sentinel links. Join prefix dllseg(first_2,head,tmp_node,prev_2,before_2) with tmp_node links to obtain dllseg(first_2,head,next_2,tmp_node,before_2++[tmp_node]); retain the exposed next_2 links and tail dllseg. The refined disjunct is the same state after suffix unfolding.
witnesses.pure_plan: From todo_2=next_2::l0 and nodes=done_2++todo_2, rewrite nodes=(done_2++[next_2])++l0. Zlength app/cons gives the new length decomposition. Since Zlength l0>=0 and total Zlength nodes<=4294967295, Zlength done_2+1 lies in [0,2^32-1], so unsigned_last_nbits(linklist_length+1,32)=linklist_length+1=Zlength(done_2++[next_2]). Non-nullness of next_2 follows from the nonempty dllseg constructor exposed by xizi_dllseg_unfold.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open or unfold xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg, move one current node across the prefix/suffix boundary, discharge list-length and unsigned-increment equations, and reclose the unchanged circular list.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use xizi_dll_open/xizi_dll_close and one group-suffixed boundary-extension helper over xizi_dllseg/xizi_dll_links; base witnesses reduce to empty-prefix or empty-list instances.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Normalize app/cons Zlength equations. On loop steps, nonempty todo plus total length <=4294967295 proves the increment stays within 32 bits. On exits, a segment whose start equals stop forces an empty logical suffix.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All five witnesses come from one traversal invariant and one segment-boundary helper family. Keeping them together permits one worker to prove and reuse the helper; 5 is below max_witnesses_per_group=12.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: A proved spatial entailment, specialized as needed, that extends xizi_dllseg first head current prev before across xizi_dll_links current next prev to xizi_dllseg first head next current (before ++ [current]); a full-resource variant may retain the suffix so separation internally discharges current<>next.

premises.premise: current is non-null and distinct from the new stop, or the supplied separated suffix resources entail that distinctness
premises.discharged_by: Explicit tmp_node non-null/non-sentinel facts cover return_wit_1; loop-step arms obtain node facts from the nonempty dllseg constructor and separation of adjacent node link cells
premises.spatial_resource: prefix segment, current links, and when required the nonempty suffix

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Proceed in manual order. Open xizi_dll for entail_wit_1. Prove one group-suffixed dllseg boundary-extension helper by induction on the prefix list (or a full-resource variant if adjacency distinctness is easiest to derive from separation). For entail_wit_2_1 and entail_wit_2_2, unfold the nonempty suffix, extend the prefix, instantiate done/todo, and show unsigned_last_nbits is identity using Zlength_nonneg and the total bound. For return_wit_1, force todo=nil at the sentinel boundary, extend/close the list, and unfold xizi_double_link_size. For return_wit_2, force the whole logical list empty and apply xizi_dll_empty_rev.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Same function, same loop invariant, same xizi_dllseg boundary movement, and same length arithmetic family. One 5-witness group minimizes duplicated helper work and complies with max_witnesses_per_group=12.
